Privacy Policy

Last updated: 6 November 2026

1. Who we are

Pixely Careers ([CONFIRM legal business name and registered address]) provides career documentation and personal branding services. Contact: [CONFIRM privacy email], WhatsApp +92 370 6404900.

2. What we collect

Information you give us: name, WhatsApp number, email, target country and role, your CV and career details, and messages you send us. Basic technical data: device, browser, pages visited and how you arrived (for example, from an ad).

3. How we use it

To prepare and deliver your documents, communicate with you about your order, provide support, improve our website and services, and measure our advertising.

4. Your CV and career documents

We use them only to provide the service you asked for. We don’t publish them or show them as samples without your written permission. Team members who work on your order can access them.

5. Sharing

We don’t sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers that help us operate (such as hosting, messaging, analytics and advertising platforms), or when required by law.

6. Cookies and analytics

We use cookies and similar tools for site function, analytics and advertising measurement. [CONFIRM tools: e.g. Google Analytics, Meta Pixel] You can control cookies in your browser [and through our cookie banner, if used].

7. How long we keep data

Order details and documents are kept for [CONFIRM period, e.g. 12 months] after delivery so we can provide revisions and support. Then they’re deleted, unless the law requires otherwise. You can ask us to delete them sooner.

8. Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example, under UK GDPR, or data protection laws in the UAE, Saudi Arabia or Pakistan), you may have the right to access, correct, delete or object to the use of your data. Contact us to make a request.

9. International transfers

We work remotely and may process data outside your country. We take reasonable steps to protect it.

10. Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data. No method is 100% secure.

11. Children

Our services aren’t directed at children under 16.

12. Changes

We may update this policy. The “Last updated” date shows the latest version.
